tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 7a (data IMPORT) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 7) and spec.md (Import & Export) first. Phase 7 is split: THIS task (7a) is import (QIF + CSV); export is a later task (7b) — do NOT build export now. Reuse existing layers: src/lib/db/ (MonetaFoxDB, Repositories, models: Account, Transaction, Category, AccountType), src/stores/ (useAccountStore, useCategoryStore, useTransactionStore, each with load/add; useAuthStore holds the in-memory `repositories`), src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx, src/lib/transactions/.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/import/** (create), src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx (add an Import entry point that opens the wizard), and new src/components/import/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/db/**, crypto/auth, other stores/pages, routes, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies (write the QIF and CSV parsers by hand — no csv library). Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it against embedded samples; drift fails it). Put it in src/lib/import/ and re-export from src/lib/import/index.ts:
- interface ParsedTransaction { date: string; amount: number; payee?: string; category?: string; memo?: string; cleared?: boolean }
- interface CsvMapping { date: string; amount: string; payee?: string; category?: string; memo?: string; dateFormat?: 'DD/MM/YYYY' | 'MM/DD/YYYY' | 'YYYY-MM-DD' }
- export function parseQIF(text: string): { type?: string; transactions: ParsedTransaction[] }
    * Read the `!Type:<X>` header (return X as `type`, e.g. 'Bank'). Parse entries delimited by `^`, with line prefixes: D=date, T=amount, P=payee, L=category, M=memo, C=cleared status (`C*` or `Ccleared`/`CX`/`CR` → cleared:true). Dates: support Microsoft Money `DD/MM'YYYY` (e.g. D05/02'2026 → 2026-02-05) INCLUDING 2-digit years (assume 20xx), and normalize every date to ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. Amounts: parse signed decimals and STRIP thousands commas (T-1,234.56 → -1234.56).
- export function detectCsvMapping(headers: string[]): Partial<CsvMapping>
    * Fuzzy-match common header names (case-insensitive) to fields: date/Date, amount/Amount, payee/Payee/Description, category/Category, memo/Memo/Notes.
- export function parseCSV(text: string, mapping: CsvMapping): ParsedTransaction[]
    * Proper CSV parsing with QUOTED fields (a quoted value may contain commas, e.g. "Tesco, Ltd"). Map columns per `mapping`; parse the date per mapping.dateFormat (default DD/MM/YYYY) to ISO; parse the signed amount (strip commas).
- export function dedupeParsed(parsed: ParsedTransaction[], existing: { date: string; amount: number; payee?: string }[]): { toCreate: ParsedTransaction[]; duplicates: ParsedTransaction[] }
    * A parsed row is a duplicate if an existing row has the same date, amount, and payee.
- export async function importTransactions(repositories: Repositories, options: { parsed: ParsedTransaction[]; target: { mode: 'new'; name: string; type: AccountType; currency: string } | { mode: 'existing'; accountId: string }; autoCreateCategories?: boolean }): Promise<{ accountId: string; created: number; skipped: number; accountsCreated: number; categoriesCreated: number }>
    * For a NEW target, create the account (crypto.randomUUID id). Auto-create any categories referenced by name that do not already exist (when autoCreateCategories). Dedupe parsed rows against the target account's existing transactions (via dedupeParsed) and insert only the new ones as Transactions (accountId set, currency = the account currency, splits none). Return counts.

UI: In src/components/import/ build a multi-step import wizard (choose file/format → for CSV, confirm/adjust the auto-detected mapping → preview parsed rows with duplicate flags → choose target account (new or existing) → run import → show the summary). Support importing MULTIPLE QIF files as separate accounts. Wire an 'Import' button on TransactionsPage that opens the wizard; read `repositories` from useAuthStore, and after a successful import refresh the account/category/transaction stores (call their load()).

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. (Suite is deterministic; one run — do NOT loop it.) Write real Vitest tests for the parsers, dedupe, and the import service (node env + fake-indexeddb for the service).

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the QIF/CSV parsing decisions (date handling, quoting, comma amounts), the dedupe rule, and any Phase 7b (export) follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures exactly; hand-write the parsers (no new deps); normalize all dates to ISO; strip comma thousand-separators; MS Money DD/MM'YYYY support is required; reuse the existing layers; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes against embedded samples (parseQIF with MS Money DD/MM'YYYY dates + comma amounts + cleared + category; parseCSV with quoted fields + mapping + date format; detectCsvMapping; dedupeParsed). The import module (incl. importTransactions), an import wizard component, and a TransactionsPage import entry point exist. The Phase 5b/3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
